botcomponent.description: Normalize coffee research workbooks and fact-check each study's claims against its measurements and scientific literature, then explain the evidence and potential product implications in plain language. Includes the fictional Bean-o-Matic 2000 product profile. Use for its product questions, study reviews, product or marketing implications of studies, normalization, claim checking, evidence briefs, or the sample studies/demo; not simple scientific definitions or arithmetic.
botcomponent.name: coffee-research-study
